validationStrategy: 80/20 Stratified Train/Test Split (N_train=4,256, N_test=1,064) + 5-Fold Stratified Cross-Validation

selectionDecision.decision: Production model retained because available evidence is insufficient to justify switching.
selectionDecision.rationale: While XGBoost achieves higher overall accuracy (99.44% vs 97.74%) and lower Brier score (0.0100 vs 0.0286), both models achieve 0/4 recall on the extreme minority Severe class (N=4 test samples) and classify them as High. Random Forest provides stable native class-balanced weights with verified operational stability on Port 8000. Production model retained because available evidence is insufficient to justify switching.
